sum: Resolution Minerals Ltd engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Australia and the United States. It primarily explores for antimony, gold, tungsten, copper, silver, and other metals. The company was formerly known as Northern Cobalt Limited and changed its name to Resolution Minerals Limited in November 2019. Resolution Minerals Ltd was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Adelaide, Australia.
ceo: Mr. Craig Thomas Lindsay C.F.A., M.B.A. (CEO of U.S. Operations)
